name: Libby
notes: Active storage estimated from USACE operating rules. Seasonal storage; key to controlling spring Kootenai runoff. Lake Koocanusa.

name: Grand Coulee
notes: Active storage = usable range 1208-1290 ft. Head varies ~330-380 ft; 380 ft used (max). Seasonal storage dam, explicit peaker. Lake Roosevelt.

name: Hungry Horse
notes: Active storage estimated; total = 3.47M AF, significant dead storage for sediment. Reservoir elevation managed for fish temperature.

name: Dworshak
notes: Active storage = total minus inactive/flood reserve. High head (560 ft) gives outsized energy per volume. Used for summer temperature management for salmon.

name: John Day
notes: Run-of-river. Large installed capacity but reservoir provides very limited storage. Pool elevation range ~2-3 ft normally. Lake Umatilla.

name: Bonneville
notes: Run-of-river. Active storage minimal — pool fluctuates only ~2 ft under normal ops. Reservoir = Lake Bonneville. Cannot meaningfully store energy.

name: Chief Joseph
notes: Run-of-river. Rufus Woods Lake; minimal storage — pool range ~26 ft (930-956 ft). High capacity but no storage capability.

name: McNary
notes: Run-of-river. Lake Wallula; pool elevation held essentially constant. Very limited active storage.
